_comment: Accuracy benchmark for /ask, grouped by `set` (default 'core'): core (grounded Q&A), adversarial_jurisdiction (must cite the user's state, never a sibling state — the key safety metric once the state filter ships), refusal (out-of-scope, must be refused), staleness (answer must contain a current figure). Per-case fields: state/locality/subject are sent to /ask; expected_sources = substrings that must appear in at least one citation (title/url/section), case-insensitive; forbidden_sources = substrings that must NOT appear in any citation; answer_must_include = substrings required in the answer text; expect_refusal = must be refused. Run one set with `python scripts/eval.py --set adversarial_jurisdiction`.
